metaDescription: Portfolio of Giovanna Marcondes, frontend developer: a night at the desk, Tutu the cat and a mug that turned into projects.
comingSoonBody: A new project is still in the kiln.

lite.tagline: I'm Gio, a frontend developer. Tutu knocked over my coffee here — and every shard became a project.
lite.sceneAlt: Night-time 3D illustration: Gio typing at a white desk, seen from behind, Tutu the cat sitting next to the WORLD'S BEST DEV mug, the desk lamp on and code on the monitor.
lite.note: light version, no 3D — same story, less motion

about.photoAlt: Giovanna smiling, wearing glasses and a black T-shirt, holding Tutu the cat in a garden
about.caption: me and Tutu (the one who broke the mug)
about.lead: Frontend developer with over 8 years of experience in technology and more than 4 years working with Flutter development, web and mobile applications, and solutions for the fintech sector.

timeline.promo: Promoted from Junior to Mid-level in Feb 2025
bullets: Mobile and web apps in Flutter/Dart, from layout to store release.
Layered architecture with MVVM, Clean Code and componentization for scalable, maintainable code.
REST API integration, async programming, Firebase and NoSQL databases.
Flutter ecosystem packages and native device features.
Angular development and backend support in .NET and JavaScript.
Fintech projects, with integrations and flows in the Matera ecosystem.
Git/Bitbucket, Jira and Azure DevOps; bridge between clients, Design and QA, executive meetings and status reports.

timeline.promo: Promoted from Intern to Junior in Apr 2020
bullets: Projects for TIM Brasil on the SIEBEL CRM.
Functional and regression testing, black, white and gray box.
SQL queries, Unix environments and Jenkins pipelines to validate scenarios.
Evidence, bug reports and status updates for Accenture and TIM.
Technical manuals that cut the team's onboarding time.
Dailies and war rooms during critical release windows.
Delphi systems backed by SQL Server, MySQL, SQLite and Firebird.
Publishing apps to Google Play and the Apple App Store.
Led the interns: task planning, technical decisions, reports and documentation.
Direct client support and a Kanban workflow.

about.languageNote: Continuously improving, with a focus on professional communication and international opportunities.
